title: Path to Breaking the Game
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped onto the path, he felt an unusual tremor from deep within the Tianji Record—was this a sign of the fourth page's shackles loosening, or a precursor to an even greater crisis?

text.content:
The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the complete Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with unprecedented radiance.

That was no ordinary light—the first light of chaos, the color of all creation's origin. Within that radiance was reflected a third possibility that even the Eyes of Heavenly Dao had never anticipated. Chen Ji felt his spiritual energy swept up by that light as the Tianji Record's pages rustled rapidly, each page burning with golden runes.

dialogue.content:
A third possibility? How dare you—!

That voice lost some of its transcendence, gaining instead a sentiment Chen Ji had never heard from the Eyes of Heavenly Dao. Fury. Yes, this supreme existence was furious for the first time.

text.content:
A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He had waited too long for this moment. The Eyes of Heavenly Dao could feel anger—it simply had never been provoked enough to lose its composure. This flaw, he noted.

"Whether I dare or not, haven't you already seen it?" His voice wascalm得近乎mocked，"Or perhaps you're accustomed to looking down on all creation, and find it uncomfortable to be countered?"

From the depths of the radiance, a figure identical to Chen Ji slowly formed. Chen Jie—his twin of fate, the 'positive' that had been calculated by him and held in high regard by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao. At this moment, Chen Jie was entangled with broken threads of karma, his brow no longer carrying its former certainty.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji gazed at that face identical to his own and suddenly laughed: "Old friend, first time I've seen you looking like a loser."

Chen Jie's eye twitched, but he offered no retort. Because Chen Ji spoke the truth—at this moment, Chen Jie was truly the loser. Abandoned by fate, abandoned by heaven.

text.content:
Chen Jie fell silent for a moment before finally speaking: "You want me to cooperate with you?"

"Not cooperation." Chen Ji corrected. "A transaction. You help me open the path to the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's core, and I'll give you one chance to turn the tables." His gaze fell upon Chen Jie with the keen scrutiny of a hunter. "What, the great Lord of Fate, afraid to gamble?"

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Jie's doubt, how should Chen Ji demonstrate the possibility of transcending the shackles?

choices.text: Demonstrate the Tianji Record's complete resonance
choices.description: Activate both the front and back of the Tianji Record simultaneously, proving he has transcended the opposition of positive and negative, unbound by heavenly laws
choices.visible_reward: Chen Jie wavers for the first time, gains qualification for the path to the core
choices.risk_hint: Massive Heavenly Fate consumption may trigger unknown backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly spread open both hands, the Tianji Record's pages fully unfurling in the void—the front ablaze with golden order's light, the back shrouded in black chaos's darkness, the two forces perfectly harmonizing in his palms.

Chen Jie's pupils contracted sharply: "Impossible... positive and negative are mutually exclusive, that is heaven's iron law!"

choices.text: Verbal provocation, exposing Chen Jie's wounds
choices.description: Use the truth of Chen Jie's abandonment by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao to provoke him, igniting the fire of resentment long suppressed in his heart, letting anger guide his choice
choices.visible_cost: Risk of deteriorating relationship with Chen Jie
choices.visible_reward: Chen Jie makes his decision in anger, cooperation is reached
choices.risk_hint: Over-stimulation may cause Chen Jie to completely side with the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

text.content: "How does it feel to be used by your biological father and then thrown away?" Chen Ji's voice carried cruel tenderness, "You didn't actually think the Eyes of Heavenly Dao would give you a good ending, did you? It just needed a obedient scapegoat, and you—happened to fit the bill."

choices.description: Acknowledge his own weaknesses and fears, move Chen Jie with sincerity, demonstrate another possibility beyond fate—not confrontation, but acceptance
choices.visible_cost: Expose own weaknesses to the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Chen Jie is touched, cooperation will be built on deeper trust
choices.risk_hint: Showing weakness may be exploited by Chen Jie

text.content: Chen Ji sheathed all his edge and spoke softly: "To be honest, I'm very tired too. Ever since I was young, I've been playing the role others expected of me." He paused. "But I don't want to be manipulated by anything anymore, including fate. What about you?"

Chen Jie's expression shifted alternately between anger and struggle. After a long while, he suddenly laughed—that smile carried a touch of self-mockery, a touch of relief.

"Chen Ji, do you know?" Chen Jie's voice dropped lower, "Ever since I was young, everyone told me I was fate's favorite, heaven's heir. But only today did I realize, there's actually no difference between us—both are chess pieces."

dialogue.content:
Enough!

The Eyes of Heavenly Dao's voice exploded like thunder, yet could no longer shake either of them. Within that voice carried a hint... Chen Ji敏锐地捕捉到了——那是fearful。超然的存在，第一次感到了fearful。

text.content:
Chen Ji and Chen Jie looked up simultaneously, exchanging a glance. In that instant, without words, they understood each other's meaning—the Eyes of Heavenly Dao was panicking.

"Seems we've found common ground." Chen Ji said calmly, "Both were heaven's chess pieces, both want to turn the tables. In that case—"

He extended his hand: "Pleasant cooperation?"

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Ji's outstretched hand, how will Chen Jie respond?

choices.description: Chen Jie grasps Chen Ji's hand without hesitation, proving his determination for cooperation through action
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose his back to a former enemy
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Jie's initial trust, unlock the special effect 'Twin of Fate'
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Jie betrays, there will be no defense

text.content: Chen Jie's palm carried a cold touch, the chill left by fate's backlash. But Chen Ji did not pull away. Their spiritual energies produced a strange resonance under the Tianji Record's witness—positive and negative, yin and yang, perfectly harmonizing in this moment.

choices.text: Cautious exploration, leave room for maneuver
choices.description: Chen Jie grasps Chen Ji's hand but remains vigilant, agreeing to act together first while retaining the right to withdraw at any time
choices.visible_cost: Cooperation not deep enough, may affect subsequent efficiency
choices.visible_reward: Maintain flexibility, reduce risk of betrayal

text.content:
Chen Jie's fingers gently rested on Chen Ji's palm, the force perfectly measured—neither trust nor hostility. "Let's take it step by step." His voice regained its composure, "But if you dare betray me—"

"Rest assured, I hate losses more than anyone." Chen Ji replied with a smile.

The moment their palms touched, the Tianji Record let out a long hum. The pages turned automatically, runes on both front and back lighting up simultaneously, weaving into a massive formation diagram in the void.

That was the path to the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's core.

Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power surging within him—the resonance between the Tianji Record's front and back was far deeper than he had imagined.

dialogue.content:
"Interesting." Chen Ji murmured, a flash of delight crossing his eyes. The front-back resonance of the Tianji Record actually made his foresight of the future even clearer—not three hours, but a full twelve.

More importantly, the consumption of each foresight was reduced by half.

text.content:
Chen Jie clearly felt the change too. His expression twisted微妙地扭曲了一瞬——那是嫉妒，是不甘，却又夹杂着一丝希望。

"So this is your底气 for challenging heaven." Chen Jie murmured, "The complete form of the Tianji Record... is actually this powerful."

Chen Ji did not respond. He quietly gazed at that path slowly forming in the void, feeling the terrifying energy it contained.

This road was very dangerous.

At his current strength, entering might mean nine deaths and one life.

choice.prompt: Facing this path to the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's core, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.text: Strike while the iron is hot, enter immediately
choices.description: Seize the initiative before the Eyes of Heavenly Dao can react, bring Chen Jie and immediately enter the path, catching the enemy off guard
choices.visible_cost: Insufficient preparation, limited ability to handle unexpected situations
choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative, Eyes of Heavenly Dao won't have time to arrange defenses
choices.risk_hint: Unknown dangers may exist in the path

text.content:
"Go!"

Chen Ji did not hesitate, grabbing Chen Jie and stepping into that radiance first. Behind them, the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's roar surged like a tide, but could no longer stop anything.

choices.text: Make steady progress, be well prepared
choices.description: Take time to make thorough preparations: recover Heavenly Fate points, arrange backup plans, notify allies, only enter after ensuring everything is foolproof
choices.visible_cost: Give the Eyes of Heavenly Dao breathing room
choices.visible_reward: Enter at full strength, reduce risks along the way
choices.risk_hint: The Eyes of Heavenly Dao may take the opportunity to counterattack

text.content:
Chen Ji suppressed his impatient mood and closed his eyes. The Tianji Record operated at high speed in his Mental Sea, deducing the countless possibilities of the future again and again.

"Give me the time of one incense stick." He opened his eyes, "There are some things that must be properly arranged."

choices.text: Cautious exploration, send a分身 first
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's power to create a clone, have it enter the path first to scout the way, only enter with his true body after ensuring safety
choices.visible_cost: Consume massive spiritual energy to create the clone
choices.visible_reward: Gain path intelligence, foresee dangers in advance
choices.risk_hint: The clone may expose their position

text.content:
Chen Ji凝聚spiritual energy于指尖，一个与他一模一样的身影从体内分离而出。那分身面无表情地踏入路径，眨眼间便被光芒吞没。

片刻后，分身的感知如潮水般涌回——"前方三里，有三道restriction......"

The moment Chen Ji stepped into the path, the surrounding scenery suddenly changed.

No longer the previous void and radiance, but a corridor with no end in sight. On both sides of the corridor were countless mirrors, each reflecting different scenes—past, present, future, endless.

Chen Jie followed closely behind, his face changing dramatically: "This is... the Heavenly Dao Corridor! The place that only heirs of heaven throughout the ages were qualified to enter!"

"Legend?" A cold smile curled Chen Ji's lips, "It seems the Eyes of Heavenly Dao really values us, giving us such high-class treatment."

However, at this moment, Chen Ji's脚步忽然一顿。

他感觉到了——天机录深处，那道沉寂已久的第四页枷锁，正在slowly松动。不是因为外力，而是因为......某种来自内部的共鸣。

"有意思。"陈机whispered道，眼底闪过一丝异色，"看来我体内的秘密，比我想象的还要多。"

Chen Jie noticed his unusual state: "What's wrong?"

"Nothing." Chen Ji收回心神，目光望向走廊深处，"走吧，真正的考验才刚刚开始。"

两人的身影在无尽的光影中渐行渐远，身后是天道之眼furious的咆哮，前方是未知的命运。

而陈机的心中，一个念头quietly浮现——第四页枷锁之下，究竟封印着什么？
